description: This file defines a custom web component 'a2ui-surface' using LitElement, which renders a UI surface with optional logo and style customization based on surface data.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: A custom web component extending Root that renders a styled surface with optional logo, using surface data and styles.

methods.name: #renderLogo
methods.description: Renders the logo image if 'logoUrl' is present in the surface styles.

methods.name: #renderSurface
methods.description: Generates style variables based on 'primaryColor' and 'font' from surface styles and renders the main surface component.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that combines logo and surface rendering.
